title: Photo Estimate Photo Set Requirements
content:
A usable photo set under Repair Estimates & Appointments contains four corners, damage close-ups, the odometer and the VIN plate, in the number of photos stated below for the estimate type. Only the Photo Estimate relies on photos; every other estimate type shows 0, meaning not applicable.

| Estimate type | Photo window (calendar days after the booking request) | Photos in a usable set | Resubmissions allowed within the window |
|---|---|---|---|
| Photo Estimate | 3 | 8 | 2 |
| Drive-In Estimate | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Scheduled Estimate | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Mobile Estimate | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Blueprint Teardown Estimate | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Structural Blueprint Estimate | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Terms

1. **Photo window** — the calendar days after the booking request within which a usable photo set must be submitted.
2. **Photos in a usable set** — the number of photos in a usable photo set: four corners, damage close-ups, odometer and VIN plate.
3. **Resubmissions allowed** — the times an unusable photo set may be resubmitted within the photo window before the booking must move to an in-person estimate.

## Questions on the photo set

**How many photos make a usable Photo Estimate set?** Eight: the set covers the four corners, the damage close-ups, the odometer and the VIN plate.

**How long does the customer have?** Three calendar days after the booking request.

**How often may an unusable set be sent again?** Twice within the photo window.
